hypotheses.T1_random_positive_transfer: The frozen 16-feature category core reaches median downstream fidelity at least 0.50 on the independent random-active surface-positive panel.
hypotheses.T2_semantic_specificity: Frozen-core fidelity on random-active positives exceeds activation-matched negatives by at least 0.20 at budget 16.
hypotheses.T3_adaptive_retention: The frozen 16-feature core retains at least 80% of adaptive per-site top-16 fidelity on random-active positives.
hypotheses.T4_small_core_transfer: The frozen 8-feature core reaches median downstream fidelity at least 0.40 on random-active positives.
hypotheses.T5_category_consistency: Every category has positive-over-matched-negative fidelity gap at budget 16.
